Messages.Author: LSJ

>===== Original Message From BWC Design <bwcd...@telocity.com> =====

>hey all...
>
>what's the 7/7 rule!? i've searched a few sites and haven't found anything.
>can someone point me in the right direction?

There is no "7/7 Rule", but there was a set of rulings and errata issued
on July 7, 1998 that became known by the 7/7 name. If you weren't around
at the time, then it probably won't matter to you - most of the stuff in
that RTR ("Rules Team Rulings") is now in the printed rulebook and/or
on the cards printed in Sabbat War (or Final Nights).
